title: Pocketwire Advance Terms — Closure of a Line
content:
**Closure by the customer.** The customer can close an active Pocketwire Advance line only when its outstanding balance is 0.00; closing is the customer's own decision and is confirmed in the app. The outstanding balance is read from the system record of the line.

**Closure by Pocketwire.** A suspended line is closed by Pocketwire after its balance was repaid in full and it is not reinstated, or after a write-off.

**Personal account closure.** Closing the Pocketwire Personal Account requires the advance line to be closed first.

A closed line records its closing date.

## Closure by the customer

| Line status | Outstanding balance | Customer closure |
|---|---|---|
| active | 0.00 | Possible, confirmed by the customer in the app |
| active | Above 0.00 | Not possible |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- An active line shows an outstanding balance of 0.00 after the customer's last advance was repaid in full. The customer can close it, and does so by confirming the closure in the app.
- An active line shows an outstanding balance of 4.10, a late fee still unpaid. The customer cannot close it while that balance stands.
- A suspended line whose unpaid balance was written off is closed by Pocketwire; it is not reinstated.
